'''2000 San Diego Comic-Con Open''' was a Star Wars CCG Open championship on Decipher's 2000 summer convention circuit. The winner received a bye to the semifinal round of the World Championship and travel to DecipherCon 2000.<ref name="dc00fin">[http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html DecipherCon 2000: Star Wars CCG Qualifiers], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010308110320/http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sc00cc">[http://www.decipher.com/tournaments/summercons2000/comiccon.html Decipher's @ Comic-Con 2000], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000817231226/http://www.decipher.com/tournaments/summercons2000/comiccon.html Internet Archive]</ref>

[[Kevin Shannon]] of Livermore, California won.<ref name="dc00fin" />

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Open championship
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Date:''' 20–23 July 2000
* '''Site:''' San Diego Comic-Con, San Diego, California

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* The List row gives 20 July 2000 (the hub gives the convention's 20–23 July); Clayton Atkin's and Alfred Dong's reports both put the Open on the Friday after Death Star II's Wednesday release, i.e. 21 July 2000.<ref name="tr-d1026" />
* The List row gives 20 July 2000 (the hub gives the convention's 20–23 July); Clayton Atkin's and Alfred Dong's reports both put the Open on the Friday after Death Star II's Wednesday release, i.e. 21 July 2000.<ref name="tr-d1035" />
